recipes.title: Cottage Cheese Chocolate Chip Pancakes (30, Meal Prep)

groups.name: Batter (makes 30; divide by 3 for a normal batch)

steps: Blend the cottage cheese, eggs, vanilla and syrup until smooth.
Stir in the self-rising flour, then fold in the chopped chocolate.
Cook on a lightly greased griddle or pan over medium-low heat (he uses ring molds for thick, even pancakes), about 3 minutes per side until set.
Cool, then refrigerate or freeze between parchment. Reheat in the toaster or microwave.
recipes.notes: Ingredients and macros (per pancake) are the creator's. Cook times are estimated from the video.
